title: Argentinian-Style German Bratwurst Bake
description: A fusion of German and Argentinian flavors in a hearty, comforting dish. This dish combines the rich flavors of bratwurst with the vibrant colors of Argentinian spices.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onions and bell peppers, cook until tender.
Add the minced garlic, cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes, cook for 2 minutes.
Add the Bratwurst Sausages, cook until browned.
In a separate bowl, mix together the bread, cheese, and Argentinian-Style Spices.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of the bread mixture.
Add a layer of the sausage mixture, followed by a layer of the tomato mixture.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of the bread mixture on top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
